commands.name: ping
commands.description: Shows message delay, uptime and memory use.

examples.output: Pong! Msg delay: 43ms | Uptime: 2m 14s | Mem: 1.4 MB

commands.name: commands
commands.description: Links to the list of commands.

examples.output: All commands: https://itsbr0dyy.dev/s/xxxxxx

commands.name: link
commands.description: Links your Last.fm or Minecraft account to your Twitch name.

examples.output: Linked your Last.fm account: itsbr0dyy
Linked your Minecraft account: Feinberg

commands.name: song
commands.description: Shows what you or another linked user is listening to on Last.fm.

examples.output: ItsBr0dyy is currently listening to "Bounty" by Rich Amiri from the album "For The Better" plays #51 elisJam https://itsbr0dyy.dev/s/zOT7Q9
someone hasn't linked a Last.fm account.

commands.name: user
commands.description: Shows Twitch account info.

examples.output: ItsBr0dyy • Affiliate • 648 followers • ID 1039455040 • created 2y 7mo ago • 46 chatters • last live 1d 5h ago • bio: "plong"

commands.name: badge
commands.description: Shows a user's current Twitch badge and what it's for.

examples.output: ItsBr0dyy's current badge is: Pichu | This badge was earned during the Pokémon First Partners Collection campaign.

commands.name: badges
commands.description: Shows which active event badges a user is missing and when the next one drops.

examples.output: ItsBr0dyy is missing 3/5 active badges (1 free) • Missing: Badge One (free), Badge Two, Badge Three • Next: "Badge Six" in 2 days, 4 hours, and 12 minutes • https://itsbr0dyy.dev/s/xxxxxx

commands.name: logs
commands.description: Links to a user's chat logs in a channel for the current month.

examples.output: https://itsbr0dyy.dev/s/xxxxxx

commands.name: subage
commands.description: Shows a user's subscription to a channel.

examples.output: bifters_friend is currently subscribed to MarkZynk with a Tier 1 gifted sub by bifter. They have been subscribed for 5 months. This sub expires in 24 days, 20 hours, and 26 minutes.
username is currently not subscribed to MarkZynk, and never has been before.

commands.name: mods
commands.description: Shows how many channels a user moderates.

examples.output: ItsBr0dyy is a moderator in 59 channels • 2 Partners • 29 Affiliates • 104,542 total followers • https://itsbr0dyy.dev/s/xxxxxx

commands.name: vips
commands.description: Shows how many channels a user is a VIP in.

examples.output: ItsBr0dyy is a VIP in 36 channels • 2 Partners • 9 Affiliates • 41,203 total followers • https://itsbr0dyy.dev/s/xxxxxx

commands.name: founders
commands.description: Shows how many channels a user is a founder in.

examples.output: someone is a founder in 3 channels • 0 Partners • 2 Affiliates • 1,204 total followers • https://itsbr0dyy.dev/s/xxxxxx

commands.name: artists
commands.description: Shows how many channels a user is an artist in.

examples.output: someone is an artist in 2 channels • 0 Partners • 1 Affiliates • 648 total followers • https://itsbr0dyy.dev/s/xxxxxx

commands.name: elo
commands.description: Shows a player's MCSR Ranked elo, rank, record and times. Uses your linked Minecraft account if you leave the name out.

examples.output: doogile Stats: Elo 2089 (Peak 2089) • Netherite (#2) • W/L: 182/61 (74.9%) • Played 255 matches • Fastest time 07:20 (avg 11:01) • FF rate 0.39%

commands.name: winrate
commands.description: Shows a player's MCSR Ranked winrate. Add "total" for all-time instead of this season.

examples.output: doogile has a 74.9% winrate this season (182W - 61L)
doogile has a 71.2% winrate all time (402W - 163L)

commands.name: record
commands.description: Shows wins, losses, forfeits and best win streak.

examples.output: doogile's record this season: 182W - 61L • 255 played • 1 forfeits (0.4%) • best win streak 8

commands.name: average
commands.description: Shows a player's average completion time and personal best.

examples.output: doogile's average time this season is 11:01.318 over 74 completions • PB 7:20.431

commands.name: 7tv add
commands.description: Adds an emote to this channel's active 7TV set. Only the broadcaster and the channel's 7TV editors can use it. Add "bot" to add it to the bot's own set, "#channel" to copy it from another channel, or "as:alias" to add it under a different name.

examples.output: (7TV) Clap has been added successfully!
(7TV) KEKWait has been added successfully from #xqc as "KEKWait"!

commands.name: 7tv remove
commands.description: Removes an emote from this channel's active 7TV set. Broadcaster and 7TV editors only.

examples.output: (7TV) Clap has been removed successfully!

commands.name: 7tv alias
commands.description: Renames an emote in this channel's active 7TV set. Broadcaster and 7TV editors only.

examples.output: (7TV) Successfully changed Clap to Clapping

commands.name: remindme
commands.description: Reminds you after a delay. Time can be like 10m, 3d, 1h30m or 2months (m is minutes, months is months).

examples.output: Okay, I'll remind you in 3 days.
Okay, I'll remind you in 1 hour and 30 minutes.

commands.name: remind
commands.description: Leaves a message for a user, delivered when they next chat. Add a time to have it posted after that delay instead.

examples.output: Okay, I'll remind bob next time they chat.
Okay, I'll remind bob in 2 hours.

commands.name: join
commands.description: Makes the bot join a channel and saves it so it rejoins after a restart.

examples.output: Joined #somechannel

commands.name: leave
commands.description: Makes the bot leave a channel. Leaves the current channel if you don't name one.

examples.output: Leaving #somechannel

commands.name: addhelper
commands.description: Gives a user helper access.

examples.output: Added somename as a helper.

commands.name: removehelper
commands.description: Removes a user's helper access.

examples.output: Removed somename as a helper.
